title: Introducing OpenAI for Nonprofits
summary: We’re launching a new initiative to enhance the accessibility of our tools for nonprofit organizations, including discounted rates for ChatGPT Team and Enterprise.
body: We’re launching a new initiative to enhance the accessibility of our tools for nonprofit organizations, including discounted rates for ChatGPT Team and Enterprise.
summaryZh: OpenAI 启动了“OpenAI for Nonprofits”计划，旨在通过提供折扣价格和专属支持，提升非营利组织获取 ChatGPT Team 和 Enterprise 等先进 AI 工具的能力。此举旨在通过降低技术门槛，支持公益机构利用大模型解决社会问题，是推动 AI 技术普惠化与社会化应用的重要举措。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该计划显著降低了非营利组织使用先进 AI 模型的门槛，推动了 LLM 的社会化应用。
